title: Sulu declared ‘stable’ in peace, security

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Following decades of armed conflict and security challenges, the Province of Sulu was officially declared having a state of Stable Internal Peace and Security (SIPS) during a ceremony at the provincial gymnasium on Thursday, Sept. 24.
